messages:
jamie: New draft for the Optimize launch post is in drive. Main ask: decide CTA strategy (gated benchmark PDF vs webinar registration), confirm benchmark wording, and lock inbound routing. Can folks take a look and fast-approve? :wave:

elaine: Thanks. Priority for legal + ops please. We want to drive high-quality leads, but not at the expense of conversion. Landing page will host two CTAs; we can split test.

samir: I'm thinking split test: variant A = prominent 'Download full benchmark' (gated), variant B = 'Register for launch webinar' (ungated). Start with 60% download / 40% webinar to favor lead capture, but we can flip if conversion tank. Track via HubSpot list + UTM.

maria: Legal quick-check: don't mention competitor names or rank claims without evidence. The line "30% lower than CompetitorX" is a hard no unless we have signed permission or public benchmark apples-to-apples. Suggest: "in our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 45% relative to the baseline configuration." Add an appendix with test parameters and raw numbers.

josh: For routing: gated form -> HubSpot form "Optimize Benchmark Download" -> workflow "Launch - Optimize - Gated Leads" -> tag contact with "Gated-Benchmark" -> if company_size > 200 create task assign to SDR: Enterprise. Webinar form -> workflow "Launch - Optimize - Webinar Registrants" -> tag list "Launch - Webinar" -> send autoresponder sequence. Sample HubSpot snippet for ops template:
```
Form: Optimize Benchmark Download Form
Workflow name: Launch - Optimize - Gated Leads
Trigger: Form submission = Optimize Benchmark Download Form
Action: Add to list: Launch - Gated - Optimize
Action: Set property: Lead Source = Blog - Benchmark
Action: If company_size > 200 -> Create task: Assign to SDR queue = Enterprise Launch
```

nora: Design checklist: hero chart (vector), three benchmark callouts, gated PDF cover, social clip 30s stat-first, and an unbranded fig for the appendix. Need final copy + approved hero stat to finish. I can have assets in CDN by EOD tomorrow if copy locks today.

elaine: Drafted new hero claim per legal guidance: "In our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 45% while improving throughput by up to 3.2x (see appendix for test rig and results)." Pushed update to doc and added an appendix section with model name, sequence length, GPU type, batch settings and raw table.

maria: That wording is acceptable with the appendix link. Please make sure appendix includes test seed, dataset, and versioned configs. I will sign off once appendix is attached and the sentence uses 'in our benchmark tests' (not broader).

samir: Great. UTMs proposal: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026, utm_content=download|webinar (set per CTA). Also create `utm_term=benchmark` for the gated PDF link.

josh: Implemented workflows in staging and left them paused for validation. Note: for the gated download, add a hidden field `lead_category=benchmark_pdf` so we can filter quickly. Also we should send `source_platform=blog` to Segment for downstream attribution.

content-bot: Publish checklist from template:
- final copy attached (elaine)
- legal signoff (maria)
- hero image + chart (nora)
- gated PDF uploaded to CDN (nora)
- HubSpot workflows ready & tested (josh)
- UTMs decided (samir)
- social copy variants (jamie)

jamie: For social experiments I propose two angles across LinkedIn/X: stat-first ("3.2x throughput") vs narrative-first ("How Optimize helps reduce inference costs"). We'll A/B on creative and headline. Also want one un-gated looker for organic audiences.

elaine: Plan to publish next Tue at 08:30 PT if everyone signs off by EOD Friday. I'll finalize the appendix links and swap in the legal-approved sentence. If no objections, I'll schedule the post and unpause workflows at publish time. :calendar:

maria: I'll do a final pass on the appendix tonight and post confirmation in this thread.

nora: I'll upload hero and PDF cover once elaine confirms copy.

josh: I'll run a quick end-to-end test on staging after final assets are uploaded and unpause on publish command.

jamie: Sounds good. Tag me when social copy is ready and I'll schedule the experiment. :rocket:
